name: 東名ジャンクション周辺に建築制限を追加
summary: 現在、条例では地区計画の区域ごとに建物の制限を定めています。今回、外環道東名ジャンクション周辺地区を対象区域に加え、同地区や喜多見地区などの建築基準を定めたり改めたりします。
changes: 外環道東名ジャンクション周辺地区を条例の適用区域に加える
同地区に容積率、最低敷地面積、壁面の位置などの基準を定める
喜多見地区などの建ぺい率・容積率などの基準を改める
田直地区などの区域や基準の記載を削る
who: 外環道東名ジャンクション周辺地区で建築を行う人や事業者
基準が改められる喜多見地区などで建築を行う人や事業者
why: 外環道東名ジャンクション周辺地区の地区計画決定に伴い、条例の適用区域を広げる必要があるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Adds building restrictions around the Tomei Junction
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Setagaya City Ordinance on Restrictions on Buildings in Areas Covered by District Plans, etc.
en.summary: The ordinance currently sets building restrictions for each district plan area. This amendment adds the area around the Tomei Junction on the Gaikan Expressway to the areas covered, and sets or revises building standards for that area, the Kitami area, and other areas.
changes: Adds the area around the Tomei Junction on the Gaikan Expressway to the areas covered by the ordinance
Sets standards for the area, including floor-area ratio, minimum lot size, and wall location
Revises standards such as building coverage ratio and floor-area ratio in the Kitami area and other areas
Removes descriptions of areas and standards for the Tanaoshi area and other areas
who: People and businesses undertaking construction in the area around the Tomei Junction on the Gaikan Expressway
People and businesses undertaking construction in the Kitami area and other areas where standards are being revised
en.why: The mayor says the area covered by the ordinance needs to be expanded because a district plan has been adopted for the area around the Tomei Junction on the Gaikan Expressway.
